name: oc-writing-focus-coyote
description: Local OC writing focus helper with configurable Coyote device triggers.

scripts.build:desktop: dotnet publish csharp\src\OCWritingFocus.Wpf\OCWritingFocus.Wpf.csproj -c Release -r win-x64 --self-contained true -p:PublishSingleFile=false -p:DebugType=None -p:DebugSymbols=false -o dist\OCWritingFocus.dependencies && dotnet publish csharp\src\OCWritingFocus.Launcher\OCWritingFocus.Launcher.csproj -c Release -p:DebugType=None -p:DebugSymbols=false -o dist
scripts.test: node --test tests/**/*.test.js && npm run test:csharp && npm run test:powershell
